android.desc:
Job Application Tracker: Simplify Your Job Application Tracking

Organize and streamline your job hunt with Job Application Tracker, the ultimate companion for job seekers. Our user-friendly app helps you stay on top of your applications, interviews, and follow-ups, all in one place.

Key Features:
- Easy Application Logging: Quickly add new job applications with essential details like job title, company, and application date.
- Status Tracking: Update and monitor the progress of each application - from "Applied" to "Interviewing" to "Accepted."
- Salary Insights: Optionally record salary information to help with your decision-making process.
- Note-Taking: Add private notes for each application to keep track of important details or interview prep.
- Web Link Storage: Save relevant URLs for easy access to job postings, company websites, or online portfolios.
- Secure and Private: Your data is stored securely and is only accessible to you.

Whether you're a recent graduate embarking on your first job search or a seasoned professional looking for a career change, Job Application Tracker helps you stay organized and focused on your career goals.

Take control of your job search journey today with Job Application Tracker!

quotes.text:
I was scrolling instagram the other day and I saw a lot of people who are applying for 100s of jobs track all their applications on a Google Sheet. 
While Google sheets gets to job done, its still not user friendly. People spend a lot of time optimizing and organizing their excel sheets.

So I thought it would be a cool weekend project to built an android app that helps you organize 100s of your job applications for free!
Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.application.job_tracker

This is my first project as an Indie hacker so please let me know the reviews and what can I do better for my next project. I am totally okay with harsh criticizm and take all the tips shared by you to make my next product better than this one!
